flows.title: Open Settings and reset the gateway restart section

flows.interaction: Gateway connects while a push token is available
flows.outcome: Settings reflects whether the gateway accepted the push token and whether it has APNs credentials configured.

steps.note: Service watches the shared transport for a connected gateway
Service calls registerPushToken with the hex device token
Extension encodes the push.register method
Extension delegates to the shared transport
GatewayClient dispatches the push request
Generic call path assigns an id and awaits the reply
Request goes out over the WebSocket
Gateway stores the token and reports whether APNs credentials exist
Reply resolves the pending request; method-not-found is tolerated

flows.summary: PushRegistrationService requests an APNs token from the OS and, once a gateway connection exists, registers it through GatewayClient+Push over the push JSON-RPC namespace. It does this once per gateway URL and token, records whether the gateway has APNs credentials, and treats a missing push.register method as non-fatal.
flows.title: Register the device for push notifications

flows.interaction: Restart button in GatewayRestartSection
flows.outcome: The section shows a busy indicator while waiting, then a success state with refreshed capabilities, or a failure reason if the gateway does not return within the timeout.

steps.note: User taps Restart; controller moves phase to busy and rejects a second tap
Controller asks the restart client extension to issue the request
Extension delegates to the shared transport
Extension encodes the gateway namespace restart method
GatewayClient dispatches the gateway method as a JSON-RPC request
Generic call path assigns an id and awaits the reply
Continuation is parked until the gateway answers
Request goes out over the WebSocket
Harness gateway acknowledges and begins restarting
Reply or disconnect resolves the pending request
Once the gateway is back, controller refreshes capabilities

flows.summary: Tapping Restart asks GatewayRestartController to restart. It refuses if busy, then calls the GatewayClient+Restart extension, which sends a gateway JSON-RPC request over the WebSocket. The controller waits for the gateway to return within a timeout, refreshes GatewayCapabilitiesStore, and publishes success or a failure reason.
flows.title: Restart the gateway

flows.interaction: Session title, pin, archive, or tag changes while connected
flows.outcome: Session titles, pins, archives, and tags stay consistent across devices, or sync silently turns off when the gateway lacks config support.

steps.note: Service keeps the shared transport for pull and push
Service reads and writes the metadata document via config get and set
GatewayClient dispatches the config method as a JSON-RPC request
Generic call path assigns an id and awaits the reply
Continuation is parked until the gateway answers
Request goes out over the WebSocket
Gateway stores or returns the shared metadata document
Reply resolves the request; method-not-found disables the service

flows.summary: SessionMetaSyncService mirrors per-session metadata to the gateway under one config key. It throttles pulls to a 10-second window, debounces pushes by about 2 seconds, merges remote and local documents newest-entry-wins, and disables itself if the gateway answers config calls with method-not-found.
flows.title: Sync session metadata with the gateway

flows.interaction: Markdown sheet appears, Reload button, Save button
flows.outcome: The sheet shows the skill's markdown and summary; Reload refreshes the text, and Save confirms the edit was written to the gateway.

steps.note: Sheet task calls readSkillMarkdown; buttons call readSkillMarkdown or saveSkillMarkdown
View model issues the read or write through its transport
Read or write SKILL.md content via the skills namespace
Transport enters its call section
Pending map guarded while registering
Continuation stored for the markdown request
Frame sent on the socket
Gateway returns or stores the markdown
View model requests a summary state for the opened skill
On-device model container generates if no cache hit
Summary cached to disk by content hash

flows.summary: Opening a skill's markdown sheet reads SKILL.md over the skills namespace; the Reload button re-reads it and Save writes edits back. Each call locks the pending-request map, registers a continuation, and sends over the WebSocket to the Harness gateway. The view model also asks SkillSummaryService for the skill's cached or freshly generated summary.
flows.title: View, reload, and save a skill's SKILL.md

flows.interaction: page appears (task: setGatewayClient, refreshIfNeeded)
flows.outcome: The skill list renders from cache immediately, then updates with the gateway catalog; per-skill summaries fill in as they are generated.

steps.note: View task fires setGatewayClient then refreshIfNeeded on the page state object
View model reads skills, loading flag and error from the shared catalog
Store keeps the WebSocket transport it will call through
Store lists skills if the cache is stale
Transport frames the skills.list request as JSON-RPC
Harness gateway returns the skill catalog
Fresh catalog is written to Application Support for next launch
One-shot background pregeneration of skill summaries starts
Gemma 3 1B summarizes SKILL.md on device (macOS)
Summaries cached by skill name and content hash

flows.summary: When SkillsCanvasView appears, its task hands the gateway client to SkillsViewModel and asks it to refresh if needed. The view model defers to the shared SkillStore, which seeds from disk, lists skills over the skills JSON-RPC namespace on the Harness gateway, persists the result, and kicks off background summary pregeneration on Apple MLX.
flows.title: Open the Skills page

flows.interaction: Reload button, Refresh button, or pull-to-refresh
flows.outcome: The list shows a loading indicator, then the refreshed skills; an error banner appears if the gateway call fails.

steps.note: Reload/Refresh button or refreshable gesture calls reload on the view model
View model delegates the reload to the shared catalog
Store requests the full skill list
If the list is empty, store scans slash commands as a fallback
Both requests go through the single WebSocket transport
Transport enters its call section for each request
Continuation stored under the request id
JSON-RPC frame sent on the socket
Harness gateway answers with skills or commands
Non-empty result saved to disk
Refresh markers recorded in UserDefaults

flows.summary: The user taps Reload or Refresh, or pulls down the list. SkillsViewModel asks SkillStore to reload; the store lists skills over the gateway, falling back to a slash-command scan through the commands namespace when the list is empty. The call is registered in the pending-request pool, sent over the WebSocket, and the result is persisted to disk and UserDefaults.
flows.title: Reload or pull to refresh the skill list

flows.interaction: Search field submit or Search button
flows.outcome: Search results replace the list contents; matching skills show install options.

steps.note: onSubmit or Search button calls search on the view model
View model uses its own transport handle for search
Search request goes to the skills namespace
Transport frames the JSON-RPC search call
Request id tracked until the reply arrives
Harness gateway runs the search
Reply is routed to the matching continuation
Search results resume the awaiting call

flows.summary: The user types a query and submits it or taps Search. SkillsViewModel calls the skills namespace directly through its own GatewayClient. The request is correlated in the pending-request pool, served by the Harness gateway, and the response is matched back through fulfillRequest.
flows.title: Search for skills
